messages:
lina: Heads-up: scheduling a minimal base-image rebuild Tue 09:00 PT to address CVE-2026-2001 and remove a few legacy tools. Need quick RBAC + KMS signer plan.

sam: +1. what's the plan for cosign key rotation? can we reuse or rotate after canary?

raj: prefer: sign staging with existing key, run canary, then rotate key and sign prod. ensures rollback path. KMS must log sign ops to audit sink for 90d.

ops-oncall: I'll reserve 09:00-10:30 and create alert: canary error-rate >1.5% for 5m -> rollback. We have a 40-pod canary pool.

lina: Preflight checklist (short): sbom + grype, reproducible flags, staging sign, canary 40 pods 30-60m, rotate key, prod sign, full rollout.

sam: IAM: create "image-signer" role limited to cosign-key with permissions getPublicKey + asymmetricSign. Use short-lived grant via iam-proxy TTL=45m.

raj: Also need registry write for cosign annotations on ephemeral token. Verifier should accept both key versions during transition. Add key id in signature envelope.

build-bot: [build-system] staging image built: gcr.io/redwood/inference-runtime:staging-4955559876 -> signed (cosign-key v5).

sam: local verify passed, pushing canary.

ops-oncall: Canary up (40 pods). Metrics stable at +10m.

raj: Confirmed sign events in KMS audit sink; forwarding to sec-observe. retention 90d.

lina: Post-rollout: run grype diff vs previous prod to detect new criticals from pruning.

sam: I'll add IAM PR and attach ephemeral binding. raj: can you update verifier to accept both keys?

ops-oncall: Owners: lina=orchestration, sam=IAM & CI changes, raj=audit & verifier, ops-oncall=schedule/rollback.

lina: Thanks. Tag me if anything noisy. I'll post final cutover notes. :white_check_mark:
